verses.t: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]
verses.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming
verses.yusufAli: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)
verses.rodwell: Hath the tidings of the day that shall OVERSHADOW, reached thee
verses.sale: Hath the news of the overwhelming day of judgment reached thee

verses.t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled
verses.pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast
verses.yusufAli: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated
verses.rodwell: Downcast on that day shall be the countenances of some
verses.sale: The countenances of some, on that day, shall be cast down

verses.t: Working [hard] and exhausted
verses.pickthall: Toiling, weary
verses.yusufAli: Labouring (hard), weary
verses.rodwell: Travailing and worn
verses.sale: labouring and toiling

verses.t: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire
verses.pickthall: Scorched by burning fire
verses.yusufAli: The while they enter the Blazing Fire
verses.rodwell: Burnt at the scorching fire
verses.sale: They shall be cast into scorching fire to be broiled

verses.t: They will be given drink from a boiling spring
verses.pickthall: Drinking from a boiling spring
verses.yusufAli: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring
verses.rodwell: Made to drink from a fountain fiercely boiling
verses.sale: They shall be given to drink of a boiling fountain

verses.t: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
verses.pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
verses.yusufAli: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari
verses.rodwell: No food shall they have but the fruit of Darih
verses.sale: They shall have no food, but of dry thorns and thistles

verses.t: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger
verses.pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger
verses.yusufAli: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger
verses.rodwell: Which shall not fatten, nor appease their hunger
verses.sale: which shall not fatten, neither shall they satisfy hunger

verses.t: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure
verses.pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm
verses.yusufAli: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful
verses.rodwell: Joyous too, on that day, the countenances of others
verses.sale: But the countenances of others, on that day, shall be joyful

verses.t: With their effort [they are] satisfied
verses.pickthall: Glad for their effort past
verses.yusufAli: Pleased with their striving
verses.rodwell: Well pleased with their labours past
verses.sale: well pleased with their past endeavour

verses.t: In an elevated garden
verses.pickthall: In a high Garden
verses.yusufAli: In a Garden on high
verses.rodwell: In a lofty garden
verses.sale: They shall be placed in a lofty garden

verses.t: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech
verses.pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech
verses.yusufAli: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity
verses.rodwell: No vain discourse shalt thou hear therein
verses.sale: wherein thou shalt hear no vain discourse

verses.t: Within it is a flowing spring
verses.pickthall: Wherein is a gushing spring
verses.yusufAli: Therein will be a bubbling spring
verses.rodwell: Therein shall be a gushing fountain
verses.sale: Therein shall be a running fountain

verses.t: Within it are couches raised high
verses.pickthall: Wherein are couches raised
verses.yusufAli: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high
verses.rodwell: Therein shall be raised couches
verses.sale: Therein shall be raised beds

verses.t: And cups put in place
verses.pickthall: And goblets set at hand
verses.yusufAli: Goblets placed (ready)
verses.rodwell: And goblets ready placed
verses.sale: and goblets placed before them

verses.t: And cushions lined up
verses.pickthall: And cushions ranged
verses.yusufAli: And cushions set in rows
verses.rodwell: And cushions laid in order
verses.sale: and cushions laid in order

verses.t: And carpets spread around
verses.pickthall: And silken carpets spread
verses.yusufAli: And rich carpets (all) spread out
verses.rodwell: And carpets spread forth
verses.sale: and carpets ready spread

verses.t: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created
verses.pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created
verses.yusufAli: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made
verses.rodwell: Can they not look up to the clouds, how they are created
verses.sale: Do they not consider the camels, how they are created

verses.t: And at the sky - how it is raised
verses.pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised
verses.yusufAli: And at the Sky, how it is raised high
verses.rodwell: And to the heaven how it is upraised
verses.sale: and the heaven, how it is raised

verses.t: And at the mountains - how they are erected
verses.pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up
verses.yusufAli: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm
verses.rodwell: And to the mountains how they are rooted
verses.sale: and the mountains, how they are fixed

verses.t: And at the earth - how it is spread out
verses.pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread
verses.yusufAli: And at the Earth, how it is spread out
verses.rodwell: And to the earth how it is outspread
verses.sale: and the earth, how it is extended

verses.t: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder
verses.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer
verses.yusufAli: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish
verses.rodwell: Warn thou then; for thou art a warner only
verses.sale: Wherefore warn thy people; for thou art a warner only

verses.t: You are not over them a controller
verses.pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them
verses.yusufAli: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs
verses.rodwell: Thou hast no authority over them
verses.sale: Thou art not impowered to act with authority over them

verses.t: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
verses.pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth
verses.yusufAli: But if any turn away and reject Allah
verses.rodwell: But whoever shall turn back and disbelieve
verses.sale: But whoever shall turn back, and disbelieve

verses.t: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment
verses.pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment
verses.yusufAli: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment
verses.rodwell: God shall punish him with the greater punishment
verses.sale: God shall punish him with the greater punishment of the life to come

verses.t: Indeed, to Us is their return
verses.pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
verses.yusufAli: For to Us will be their return
verses.rodwell: Verily to Us shall they return
verses.sale: Verily unto us shall they return

verses.t: Then indeed, upon Us is their account
verses.pickthall: And Ours their reckoning
verses.yusufAli: Then it will be for Us to call them to account
verses.rodwell: Then shall it be Our's to reckon with them
verses.sale: Then shall it be our part to bring them to account
